subject: Close plan reset: StellarNet MAP & evaluation delays
thread_summary: Customer evaluation timeline has slipped due to SOC2 evidence and internal test lab availability. Team proposes a formal 60-day close extension, updated MAP with milestone dates, and a one-time credit. Leadership approval requested; DocuSign amendment and updated MAP to be delivered once approved.
messages:
From: Nora Singh <nora@stellarnet.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & PoC timeline check-in

Priyom —

Quick update from our side: we ran into an internal compliance gate this morning. The security team discovered a gap in the SOC2 artifacts we requested and have paused the PoC environment allocation until we get a couple of items from Redwood (detailed evidence and a short architecture note). This effectively pushes our internal evaluation window by ~3 weeks. Procurement is nervous about the previously quoted close date because their board wants Q4 visibility.

Can you share the latest MAP and an updated risk log so I can show our steering committee what mitigation steps are in place? If we need to push the close by a month or two, we need to surface that now.

Thanks,
Nora Singh
Director, Cloud Programs
StellarNet

[attachment: none]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Nora Singh <nora@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & PoC timeline check-in

Nora —

Thanks for the heads up and sorry for the friction. I’m attaching the latest MAP (Stellar_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short risk summary. High level: we see three items that can be done in parallel to recover time:

- Security evidence packet: we’ll collate the SOC2 artifacts + short architecture note (ETA 48 hours).
- Dedicated evaluation window: our test infra team can reserve a nightly slot to run the workload-heavy runs you need (Hannah to confirm timing).
- Acceptance criteria: we’ll narrow the eval pass/fail criteria to a core subset so you can sign off earlier and leave follow-ups as post-close items.

If the committee needs a formal close-date reset, we should document a MAP amendment (milestones + new target close) and route it through procurement. I’m looping Hannah and Monica to add technical and procurement perspective.

Attached: Stellar_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with proposed dates) and MAP-risk-log.csv (short risks/mitigations).

Next steps I propose (brief):
1) We deliver SOC2 item set by Thu 11/05.
2) Calendar a 60-minute re-eval block starting week of 11/09.
3) If eval finishes by 11/20, target close 11/30; otherwise we request an extension to 01/03 and produce an amendment.

Sound reasonable?

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[attachments: Stellar_MAP_v3.xlsx, MAP-risk-log.csv]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Nora Singh <nora@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & PoC timeline check-in — technical blockers + mitigation

Nora / team —

Quick technical note from the PoC lead: the SOC2 artifact they requested relates to key management and audit log retention for our private deployment option. We have the artifacts but need to produce a consolidated package and a one-page architecture note that calls out KMS/HSM integration and log export paths. I can produce the package by EOD Thu (11/05) if we prioritise it.

Risk items (from MAP-risk-log.csv):
- Risk 1: SOC2 evidence package incomplete -> Impact: evaluation pause -> Mitigation: consolidate artifacts + architecture note (ETA 11/05).
- Risk 2: Nightly runner availability limited -> Impact: extended evaluation -> Mitigation: reserve dedicated runner windows and off-hours runs (Hannah to schedule).
- Risk 3: Acceptance criteria too broad -> Impact: failure to converge -> Mitigation: narrow criteria to top-3 success metrics.

I’ll schedule the 60-minute heavy-run block for Thu night and a follow-up on Monday. If procurement needs formal dates we should capture them in a short amendment.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Nora Singh <nora@stellarnet.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & PoC timeline check-in — procurement impact + suggested terms

Team —

From a procurement perspective, StellarNet’s board needs a clear target quarter. Our options:

A) Keep the current Q4 target and compress evaluation (higher Redwood operational support) — offer a modest one-time credit (2 weeks of service credit) if they sign before 11/30.
B) Formal extension to 2027-01-03 with no credit, include an explicit MAP amendment and DocuSign route.
C) Hybrid: 30-day extension + reduced credit on execution.

I recommend option C given the uncertainty; it preserves urgency and keeps the commercial terms reasonable. If the customer wants an explicit credit we’ll need leadership sign-off. I’ve created a HubSpot timeline note (link included) and a draft DocuSign amendment placeholder.

Monica Patel
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: none]

From: Ben Choi <ben.choi@stellarnet.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Nora Singh <nora@stellarnet.com>
Cc: StellarNet Procurement <procurement@stellarnet.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & PoC timeline check-in — procurement view

Priyom / Nora —

Procurement concurs that the SOC2 pause requires a formal adjustment to the schedule. Our internal auditors will not greenlight Q4 spends without the artifacts. We are prepared to sign an amendment, but we need:
1) Confirmed MAP with milestone dates for evidence delivery and eval windows.
2) DocuSign amendment reflecting new close date.
3) A statement of any credits or concessions.

We can move on a 30-day extension today if Redwood provides the confirmed MAP and DocuSign. A 60-day extension will require board sign-off.

Thanks,
Ben Choi
Senior Procurement Manager
StellarNet

[attachment: none]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Escalation: RDW-4782 — request for 60-day extension and one-time credit

Marissa —

Summary: StellarNet (RDW-4782) hit a SOC2 evidence gate that paused their PoC and pushed evaluation out ~3 weeks. Procurement will accept a 30-day extension now but says a 60-day extension requires board approval. We are proposing a hybrid commercial approach (30-day extension + small credit; or 60-day extension + larger one-time credit).

Impact if not approved: risk of slipping the deal to H1 2027 and higher acquisition cost. MAP and risk log attached.

Requested action: approval to offer a one-time credit up to $12,000 for a 60-day close extension OR approval to commit to the 30-day extension without credit. Prefer the former to preserve momentum.

Marissa reply (inline):

> Priyom — approved. Offer up to $12k credit for a 60-day extension to cover evaluation friction; prioritize MAP amendment and DocuSign today. Monica, please draft the amendment and mark it as leadership-approved. Hannah — expedite the evidence bundle for delivery Thu and confirm the eval timeslot. I’ll touch base with the finance partner if anything needs additional sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

[attachments: none]
